levels.title: The Bridge
levels.goal: Get the builder ★ to the flag ⚑
levels.brief: Our builder must reach the far side of the river. The only bridge is covered by enemy gunslingers. Keep the builder alive.
tips: Numbered markers show the enemy's plan, in the order it happens.
Buildings stop shots. The builder can put one up in 2 turns.
Quick moves (ϟ) and charges (») jump to the front of the queue.
